sources.usage: Narrow Python protocol port: official login/refresh, edition-specific headers and origins, international conversation/chat/growthEvent and points pagination. Full upstream application stays outside this repository.
Protocol and response-field comparison only; no bundled upstream code.

Protocol observation only: same-origin SSO, personal-account web grant and account switch. No frontend code copied. Independently issued bearer verified through the official plugin account endpoint without cookies.

changes: Use the existing one-account Task runner and schema v1; no GUI, background scheduler, notification SDK, DNS fallback or proxy selection.
Bind private sessions and daily intent to edition and UID; save rotated tokens before further requests.
Reconcile uncertain check-in writes by reads and never replay an uncertain international activity request.
Use the authorized fixed international model hy3 and prompt only print:1.
Require complete usable chat responses and keep request confirmation separate from unverified reward attribution.
Treat missing status/point fields as unknown, permit the legacy status route only on 404, and reject incomplete points pagination.

Optional one-time CookieCloud bootstrap reads only the edition-specific web domain, follows bounded same-origin SSO, requires one enabled personal account, and verifies the new bearer identity without browser cookies.
